statement: Adding more graph context to an LLM can improve multi-hop question answering: in SG-RAG MOT, merging highly overlapping retrieved subgraphs (up to a point) and ordering the triplets yields more precise answers on MetaQA.

evidence.quote: We also find out that merging (up to some point) highly overlapping subgraphs and defining an order among the triplets helps the LLM to generate more precise answers.
